🚨🚨🚨 #Coinbase Derivatives postpones #DOGE contract debut to April 29.

Coinbase has rescheduled the introduction of Dogecoin (DOGE) futures contracts from April 1st to April 29th after submitting letters regarding the planned contracts to the CFTC for self-certification.
